reviewedClaims.claim: Exception carrier: four explicit constructors retain an IRestErrorCode and optionally an Object payload. Constructors without an explicit message pass errorCode.getMessage() to RuntimeException; message-taking overloads pass msg. The payload is assigned only by overloads accepting data.
unknownFields: Payload schema and downstream consumers were not traced
HTTP serialization and handler mapping are outside this reviewed claim

reviewedClaims.claim: Scheduling hub: start submits a polling loop to boss; due entries acquire their working flag with compareAndSet before worker submission, update last-execution time, and clear the working flag in the worker finally block. put overloads validate positive periods, non-null actions and duplicate task names; remove can interrupt actions. Shutdown methods request executor shutdown and change runState, without awaiting termination.
unknownFields: Lambda execution is not represented as a complete call graph
Task interruption and executor termination behavior were not runtime-tested
No thread-safety or shutdown-completion guarantee is asserted

reviewedClaims.claim: JSON authentication boundary: attemptAuthentication rejects non-POST requests, compares the content type against two JSON constants, deserializes the request stream into requestClazz, optionally decrypts username and password, sets authentication details and delegates to the configured authentication manager. AuthenticationException is rethrown; other exceptions inside the deserialization/authentication try block become BadCredentialsException. Content-type access occurs before that try block.
unknownFields: Filter-chain registration and effective request routes were not resolved
Authentication-manager implementation and decryptor behavior remain unverified
No dependency API compatibility or runtime authentication success is asserted

reviewedClaims.claim: Security bean configuration declares conditional bean methods for authentication success/failure, access denial, authentication entry point and logout success. Success/failure/logout factories pass optional post-handler lists when present; the entry-point factory supplies an empty mapping. Source annotations enable FairycharSecurityProperties and request ordering after RedisAutoConfiguration; effective runtime activation is not established.
